label: Breakout
description: Fires when a scan finds a ticker whose Breakout Score is at or above your value (the scanner's supporting technical score, not the 0-100 HSF Score). Lower values fire more often.

label: Watchlist
description: Fires when any ticker on your watchlist shows up in the scan results.

label: Price
description: Fires when a ticker crosses a price you set.

label: % move
description: Fires when a ticker moves more than ±X% vs yesterday's close. Checked live (about every 60 s) during extended hours.

label: Relative volume
description: Fires when a ticker trades at X times its 20-day average volume. Checked live (about every 60 s) during extended hours.

label: EMA cross
description: Fires when EMA 9 crosses EMA 21. Bullish is a short-term Golden Cross; bearish is a short-term Death Cross.

label: EWO cross
description: Fires when the Elliott Wave Oscillator (SMA 5 − SMA 35 of close) crosses zero. Up is a bullish momentum flip; down is bearish.
